provenance_note: Search outputs were remotely sealed. Blinded packets and adjudication files were generated afterward. This audit does not assert its own or packet remote presence at the search seal.

not_equivalent_to: an exact count of every distinct bibliographic document
decision.basis: Each credited anchor is a distinct substantive original-search primary work. Several families intentionally merge separate documents/functions; this lowers rather than pads the count. Primary status includes first-party specification/design/API work and first-party implementation testimony, with explicit type limits.

credit_selection_rule: Choose one substantive original-search read used by a returned candidate per conservative family, normally the earliest qualifying direct-read timestamp. Exclude nonfinal support as an additional anchor. These carriers are bookkeeping identities, never exclusive arm discovery wins.

historical_counting_rule: Current primary-source eligibility and the exact source/mechanism availability on the request date are independent axes. Postdated sources may count in the present-day source audit but cannot be presented as historical discovery evidence. No historical aggregate is inferred.
integrity_note: The R4–R6 review records original R6 discussion exposure at 2026-11-24T02:29:49Z. Original search acquisitions were earlier and sealed; candidate rereads were recorded before the exposure. Retaining those source families does not rehabilitate the post-exposure R6 judgments for strict original-discussion-blind outcome comparisons. The discussion row receives zero credit.
important_limits: This is a record audit of the allowed consolidated ledgers/candidate table, not a replay or new byte-level verification of original tool outputs.
Independent reread failure is not proof that an original substantive read never occurred; Function-node exclusion is a conservative unresolved-evidence decision.
Mirrors are not universally nonprimary. The unpkg exclusion here follows its recorded rewritten extraction and unverified integrity/source-commit linkage.
Primary guidance about a publisher own standard/product is not the same evidentiary kind as independently verified implementation source.
Different URLs, chapters, original_work_id spellings, commits, or method arms do not create distinct source origins.
